task: Move the open gripper between two approved points above the default scene without contacting any object.

verified: The official client connected to the cell during an approved supervised slot.
The real robot executed the policy's conservative home-to-A TCP trajectory.
The gripper remained open and the recorded views show no object contact.
The operator scored both recorded rollouts successful, with zero faults and zero interventions.
The platform recorded two 10 Hz LeRobotDataset episodes with table, side and wrist video plus state, TCP pose and action telemetry.
not_verified: The A-to-B leg did not execute even though both recorded rollouts received the official success label.
The run does not validate grasping, perception, custom fingers, autonomous execution or unattended control.
conclusion.root_cause_of_partial_path: Both episodes approached A to approximately 2.54 mm, but the policy required 2.00 mm or less before advancing to B.
conclusion.corrective_action: Use a 5 mm completion gate for this non-contact commissioning path, retain the 2 mm per-action motion limit, and calibrate task-specific tolerances before precision manipulation.

privacy: The private results URL, view key, request secret and run token are intentionally excluded.
data_quality_note: The machine-local approved_by rows contain the literal placeholder OPERATOR NAME, so they are not valid operator-identity evidence. The launcher now rejects that placeholder.
